verdicts.reason: A keeps '20% off' as a large one-line focal point with its subcopy beneath and a recognisable can, but the Shop Sale button sits far left before the headline, which breaks reading order. 'WEEKEND ONLY' is stranded above the button, away from the headline, and the legal copy is about as heavy as the subcopy. B breaks the headline into '20% / off' across two lines, wraps the subcopy into a cramped three-line block, and squeezes the can down to an illegible sliver jammed against the Shop Sale button. It also strands 'WEEKEND ONLY' above the button, and the legal text crowds the right edge, so the whole banner reads as cluttered fragments.
